stem: Sodium halide salts react with concentrated sulfuric acid at room temperature.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Write an equation to represent the reaction of $\text{NaCl(s)}$ with concentrated sulfuric acid.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: $\text{NaI(s)}$ reacts with concentrated sulfuric acid, at room temperature, to form steamy fumes.
parts.text: Identify the chemical responsible for the steamy fumes.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The reaction of $\text{NaI(s)}$ with concentrated sulfuric acid continues, forming several other products, including a dark grey solid.

Identify the chemical responsible for the dark grey solid and one other product of this further reaction.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain the differences in observations, at room temperature, when $\text{NaI(s)}$ reacts with concentrated sulfuric acid compared to those for $\text{NaCl(s)}$.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Complete the equation for the reaction of $\text{Br}^-$ with excess concentrated $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ at room temperature.

$$\ldots\ldots\text{Br}^- + \ldots\ldots\text{H}^+ + \ldots\ldots\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4 \rightarrow \ldots\ldots$$
